turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a and an?
turns.tutor:
Look at this: apple. The word starts with the sound a. So I write an apple.
Use an when the next word starts with the sound a, e, i, o or u; use a before other sounds.
Right: I have a pen. Wrong: I have an pen.
Now you. Write the missing word only.
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
